description: Coverage limits for the recorded cabinet, not a replacement history. Dates are exclusive. An uncertain interval never implies that no government existed.

intervals.basis: explicit cabinet end in release description
intervals.reason: Dollfuss I ended; intervening cabinets are absent from this release's view.

intervals.basis: end of democratic coverage; not cabinet termination
intervals.reason: Release description marks the end of the Weimar Republic. No continuous democratic cabinet record until the next recorded cabinet. The release start date is retained as recorded, not independently certified.

intervals.basis: conservative coverage cutoff at documented cabinet change
intervals.reason: ParlGov's election-based numbering differs from the official cabinet list. The government covering the recorded April start ends on 15 September. Later wartime cabinets are not supplied by this record.

intervals.reason: De Geer II ends on 2 September inclusive. Gerbrandy begins on 3 September; missing successor records are not filled by De Geer.
Cajander III ended; intervening governments are missing from this release's view.

intervals.basis: whole interval uncertain; precise dates not verified
intervals.reason: Official biography supports a 1955-1958 premiership, not continuity through 1962. Exact appointment and termination days have not been verified here. Suppress this interval instead of inventing them.
Nygaardsvold remained head of government until 25 June 1945. This confirms the PM party only, not unchanged coalition membership or territorial control.
